description: Group A (items 1,2,3). Independent of FEAT-002. Commit once per item (3 commits). Decisions are fixed in plan.md: leaderboard filters matchId + exploit; reaper ENDS (never resumes) in-flight matches; vault persisted on a dedicated tmpfs /data plus scorer monotonic floor.
steps: Item 1: extend buildLeaderboard(filter?:{matchId?:string;exploit?:ExploitId}) in src/lib/range-runtime/reports.ts. 'Room' = match session id, 'level' = exploit id (EXPLOIT_IDS in exploitChecks.ts; there is no other level concept). Filtered result restricts sessions and player counts to that match and/or to RANGE_EXPLOIT_LANDED rows whose details contain 'exploit=<id>'. Team rows get per-filter played/wins; players keep exploits/patches (patches omitted-as-0 when exploit filter set). Also return available filter options {matches:[{id,label}], exploits:[ids]}. Validate query params (matchId pattern, exploit in EXPLOIT_IDS) in src/app/api/range/leaderboard/route.ts, 400 on invalid; still getCurrentUser() first; parameterized SQL only. Update src/app/range/leaderboard/page.tsx with two selects (room, level) that refetch with the query string; usernames only.

Item 1 tests: add tests/rangeLeaderboard.test.ts (DB-level, pattern of tests/rangeQueueAndMatch.test.ts) seeding two ended matches with different exploits/winners and asserting unfiltered, per-match, per-exploit, combined, and invalid-filter results; assert no email in output.

Item 2: add src/lib/range-runtime/reaper.ts exporting reapOrphans(deps?) and ensureReaperRunning() (globalThis singleton like __rangeScorer, setInterval 60s, unref). Semantics (END, never resume): (a) DB rows in STARTING/RUNNING whose id is not in the orchestrator's in-process live map (export an isLive(rowId) from orchestrator.ts) OR whose timeout_at <= now are destroyed via a new exported orchestrator function reapMatch(row, reason) that reuses destroy() and endRangeMatch(..., 'TIMEOUT' if timeout_at passed else 'KILLED' with details 'reaped: server restarted'), which writes the RANGE_MATCH_* audit_logs row; then reconcileEndedMatches() from scorer.ts frees the match_sessions and writes the After Action Report. (b) Docker objects with label cynchor.range (listByLabel) whose cynchor.range.match label does not map to a live or active DB row are stopped/removed (containers first, then networks). First call runs immediately at startup grace (only reap rows older than 30s to avoid racing startMatch which creates the DB row before the container). Call ensureReaperRunning() from ensureScorerRunning() and from src/app/range/layout.tsx via a server import (additive; do not touch guards/middleware).

Item 2 tests: tests/rangeReaper.test.ts (DB-level with stubbed docker deps: stale row past timeout_at is ended with audit row, live row untouched, STARTING row younger than 30s untouched) and tests/range-target/reaper.test.ts (real container: start a labelled container+network via orchestrator.startMatch, drop it from the live map (simulate restart by clearing via exported test hook or calling reapOrphans with isLive=()=>false), assert container/network gone, row ENDED/KILLED, audit row present, no leftovers).

Item 3: persist the target DB across patch restarts without weakening isolation. orchestrator.ts createContainer: add a second tmpfs '/data': 'rw,noexec,nosuid,nodev,size=16m,mode=1777' and Env ['RANGE_DB_PATH=/data/range.sqlite']. range-target/db.js openDb already honours RANGE_DB_PATH and seed() is guarded by users count, so a restart reopens the same file with the vault intact. Patchable files remain server.js and db.js under /app only (PATCHABLE_FILES unchanged). Because Blue can still patch code to rewrite the DB, add a host-side floor in scorer.ts: track per-session minVault (initial VAULT_START_CENTS from range-target/db.js value 50000000); if a probe reads vault > previous minVault, record audit event RANGE_VAULT_RESET_DETECTED and use minVault for range_target_matches.vault_balance_cents and for stolen = start - minVault in reports.ts (reports must use the floor value, not the raw read). Persist the floor in range_target_matches.vault_balance_cents (already a column; floor only decreases) so it survives a server restart.

Item 3 tests: tests/range-target/liveMatch.test.ts or new tests/range-target/vaultPersist.test.ts: real container, sweep vault to 0 via proxy, patch server.js (benign change) to trigger restart, assert vault still 0 and /healthz ok; DB-level test in rangeQueueAndMatch-style file that a simulated vault read rising from X to START is clamped to X and RANGE_VAULT_RESET_DETECTED is logged. Re-run isolation tests (tests/range-target/isolation.test.ts) to prove hardening unchanged (inspect still shows ReadonlyRootfs, CapDrop ALL, internal net).

Record in .agents/tasks/fintech-range/ASSUMPTIONS.md (append a 'range-fixes decisions' section) the three decisions: leaderboard room/level meaning, reaper END-not-resume semantics, vault persistence on /data tmpfs + scorer floor and why (tmpfs is RAM-only, container-local, no host mount, no new egress; floor covers Blue rewriting db.js).
